+/// The rescue menu: the same detected-CLI/API-route choices init shows, with
+/// the failing route's escape hatches appended. Returns None for keep/cancel
+/// (the original refusal is then surfaced verbatim).
+fn rescue_provider_selection(
+    refusal: &setup::SetupRefusal,
+    registry: &ProviderRegistry,
+) -> Result<Option<String>> {
+    let mut choices = provider_picker_choices(registry);
+    choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
+        "keep",
+        "Keep the configured route anyway",
+        refusal.try_line.clone(),
+    ));
+    choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel"));
+    let selection = prompt::select_one(&prompt::SelectPrompt {
+        title: format!("{} — pick another route for this launch", refusal.message),
+        help: Some(
+            "this launch only; make it permanent with: deadreckon config provider <route>"
+                .to_string(),
+        ),
+        choices,
+        default_index: 0,
+    })?;
+    Ok(match selection.id.as_str() {
+        "keep" | "cancel" => None,
+        route => Some(route.to_string()),
+    })
 }

+#[test]
+fn rescue_never_fires_off_tty_refusal_is_byte_identical() {
+    let temp = repo_tempdir();
+    let repo = clean_git_repo(&temp);
+    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::from_home(temp.path().join("home"));
+    fs::create_dir_all(paths.home()).expect("home");
+    fs::write(
+        paths.config_path(),
+        "default_provider = \"anthropic\"\n\n[providers.anthropic]\nkind = \"anthropic\"\n",
+    )
+    .expect("config");
+
+    let output = deadreckon(&paths)
+        .current_dir(&repo)
+        .args(["start", "rescue off tty", "--mode", "run", "--yes"])
+        .output()
+        .expect("start");
+
+    assert!(!output.status.success());
+    let text = format!("{}{}", stdout(&output), stderr(&output));
+    assert!(
+        text.contains("provider anthropic needs credentials or an installed binary"),
+        "{text}"
+    );
+    assert!(text.contains("export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"), "{text}");
+    assert!(
+        !text.contains("pick another route"),
+        "rescue leaked into a non-TTY flow: {text}"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn start_pty_with_unusable_default_offers_provider_picker_then_launches() {
+    let temp = repo_tempdir();
+    let repo = clean_git_repo(&temp);
+    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::from_home(temp.path().join("home"));
+    fs::create_dir_all(paths.home()).expect("home");
+    fs::write(
+        paths.config_path(),
+        "default_provider = \"anthropic\"\n\n[providers.anthropic]\nkind = \"anthropic\"\n",
+    )
+    .expect("config");
+    let bin = temp.path().join("bin");
+    write_fake_path_binary(&bin, "codex", "printf 'codex-cli 9.9.9\\n'\n");
+
+    let output = deadreckon_pty(
+        &paths,
+        &repo,
+        &["1", "1", "1"],
+        &["start", "rescue then preview", "--mode", "run", "--preview"],
+        "pick another route",
+        Some(&bin),
+    );
+
+    let text = format!("{}{}", stdout(&output), stderr(&output));
+    assert!(
+        text.contains("pick another route for this launch"),
+        "{text}"
+    );
+    assert!(text.contains("cli:codex"), "{text}");

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-06-10 21:19:27Z)**_

After reviewing the three changed files and tracing the data flow:

1. **`prompt.rs`**: Adds a small `is_tty()` helper that just checks stdin AND stdout terminals — no sink.
2. **`main.rs` (`provider_setup_selection`)**: Wraps the existing `select_provider_setup` call. On refusal, if `require_usable_route` is set AND on a TTY AND the message matches `"needs credentials"` / `"not logged in"`, it opens a menu of routes drawn from `provider_picker_choices(registry)`. The chosen route is fed back into `select_provider_setup` with the SAME request (including `require_usable_route: true`), so the security validator still runs — the rescue gives a new candidate, not a bypass.
3. **`prompt_provider` / `provider_picker_choices`**: Pure refactor — the loop body (descriptor iteration, hardcoded `anthropic`/`openai`/`openai-compatible` entries) is identical to the prior version; `command_exists` is a PATH-presence check (no exec), and `probe_cli_auth` already existed in the prior init flow.
4. **Rescue choice IDs are bounded** by registry descriptor IDs + hardcoded `anthropic`/`openai`/`openai-compatible` + `keep`/`cancel`. `keep`/`cancel` return `None` → original refusal returned verbatim, no bypass. Any other ID becomes `explicit_provider` on a fresh `select_provider_setup` call with the security gate still active.
5. **No second-rescue loop**: the inner call uses `.map_err(setup_refusal_error)` directly, so a second unusable choice cannot recurse.
6. **Off-TTY parity**: `is_tty()` gate ensures CI/scripts get the exact prior refusal bytes (test `rescue_never_fires_off_tty_refusal_is_byte_identical` asserts this).
7. **Substring matcher (`refusal_is_rescueable`)** is permissive but only opens an interactive picker — no enforcement boundary is crossed by a false positive.

No new sinks (shell, FS, network, eval) are introduced. No authorization/validation gate is removed or weakened. The change is a UX rescue layer that re-enters the same validator with a different user-chosen route.
